UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_Tooltip: Shows the skill list in its own resizable window.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_Sidebar: Show button on the left sidebar
UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_Sidebar_Tooltip: Adds a button below the icons on the left of the screen that opens/closes the skills window.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_HideTab: Hide skills tab in character info
UI_SurvivorComforts_F08_HideTab_Tooltip: Removes the Skills tab from the Info/Health/Protection window. The vanilla skills key then opens the skills window instead.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F07_Tooltip: In the add-ingredient menu (soup, salad, etc.), the same ingredient is listed once and the one with the least left is used first.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F03_Tooltip: In the crafting and building windows, right-click an ingredient and choose Show recipes to see the recipes that make it. The Back button left of the search box returns to what was shown before.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F14_Tooltip: This mod's searches (the crafting and building windows, the inventory search) also find things by English name when the game is in another language. In the crafting and building windows, only for searches with Latin letters. Turn it off to search by the game's language only.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F02_Tooltip: Adds a search box to the inventory and nearby container lists that narrows the list by name (words separated by spaces must all be in the name). The magnifier button in the list header opens and closes it. Hiragana and katakana are treated as the same. Whether English names are searched too follows "Search by English name too". While searching, "Loot all" and "Transfer all" move only the matching items. Based on Inventory Search by itsu07.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F02_Dim_Tooltip: Puts the items that match the search at the top of the list and shows the others below them, dimmed. Turn it off to hide the others.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F04_Tooltip: While reading, shows under the character how long until the book is finished. Game time is shown in orange, real time in green.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_Tooltip: Right-click an item to add it to your wishlist; it is then highlighted in the inventory and loot windows. The list is saved on this PC only, not in the world.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_Sidebar: Show button on the left sidebar
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_Sidebar_Tooltip: Adds a button below the icons on the left of the screen that opens/closes the wishlist.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_Empty: Right-click an item to add it
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_UseShared_Toolti: Share items from your wishlist to show them on a shared list everyone on the server can see. Only the player who shared an item can unshare it. Shared items are shown in light blue.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_ShareLimit: You can share up to 30 kinds of item
UI_SurvivorComforts_F06_SharedFull: The shared list is full (300 kinds of item)
UI_SurvivorComforts_F10_Tooltip: Hides the PvP (skull) button on the left and keeps PvP off. The button and the key no longer toggle it.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F13_Tooltip: Hides the user panel button (factions, safehouses and more) on the left of the screen and moves the buttons below up. While it is hidden, the windows in the user panel (factions, safehouses, tickets, server settings and more) cannot be opened either. Untick this to bring the button back when you need them. Admins always see it.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F12_Tooltip: Right-click an item in the inventory or loot window and choose Show recipes to open the crafting window filtered to the recipes that make it.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F09_Tooltip: Lists the players online on the server and those who were online in the last 7 days. Multiplayer only.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F09_Sidebar: Show button on the left sidebar
UI_SurvivorComforts_F09_Sidebar_Tooltip: Adds a button below the icons on the left of the screen that opens/closes the player list.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F15_Tooltip: Click an online player in the player list to see their skill levels in a window. Multiplayer only. Based on Skill Viewer by itsu07.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F15_NoData: No data (the player may not be online)
UI_SurvivorComforts_F17_Tooltip: Shows in a window, for each skill, who has the highest level among the players online on the server, and that level. Players at the same level are all shown. Multiplayer only.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F17_Key: Open/close the best at each skill
UI_SurvivorComforts_F17_Sidebar: Show button on the left sidebar
UI_SurvivorComforts_F17_Sidebar_Tooltip: Adds a button below the icons on the left of the screen that opens/closes the best at each skill.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_Tooltip: Search items and buildings by name and see in a window how they are made (crafting, building and cooking), how they are repaired, and what they are used for (as an ingredient or a tool). Materials open to how they are made, and the Can make box narrows the list to what can be made with what is at hand. Uses the recipes the game has loaded, so mods' recipes show too. Based on the app PZ Recipe Finder by itsu07.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_Sidebar: Show button on the left sidebar
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_Sidebar_Tooltip: Adds a button below the icons on the left of the screen that opens/closes the recipe finder.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_Dim: With "Can make", show what cannot be made dimmed
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_Dim_Tooltip: When "Can make" is ticked in the item finder, what can be made now is listed first and what cannot is shown dimmed below. Off: what cannot be made is hidden.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_Hidden_Tooltip: Item finder also shows the cooking recipes the game hides.
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_Placeholder: Search by item name (e.g. hammer, plank)
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_Select: Pick an item from the list on the left
UI_SurvivorComforts_F16_NotMade: No recipe makes this (found, foraged, taken apart, ...)
